456.issue_title: Compact actionable tool summaries in presentation responses

cycles.name: Presentation configuration and alignment

deliverables.description: Frozen schema represents recursive collections, inline scalar sequences, max_items, omission/truncation wording, and the global text budget.
Startup alignment recursively validates collection fields, types, placeholders, duplicates, inline sequences, max_items usage, and mandatory-tail budget.
Global presentation configuration supplies the 8,000-byte ceiling and omission/truncation wording.
Durable schema and alignment tests cover accepted and rejected contracts.
Startup alignment enforces deterministic exact parity between registered public tool names and presentation.yaml keys and rejects duplicate registered names.

cycles.exit_criteria: Valid configuration loads; registered public tools and presentation keys match exactly; every designed invalid contract fails with actionable context; focused tests and file-scoped gates pass; no tool-name dispatch or registry ownership shift.

cycles.name: Generic sequence and collection presentation

deliverables.description: Standalone SafeNoneFormatter renders bounded flat scalar sequences generically.
CollectionTextRenderer renders scalar, model, sibling, and nested lists depth-first in DTO order.
Durable public-contract coverage spans empty, exact, over-limit, None, multibyte, sibling, and nested cases.
Formatter and renderer contain no tool dispatch, sorting, filtering, or model-list Python representation.
Missing fields, non-list runtime values, and wrongly typed collection items fail with ConfigError containing usable field/path context.

cycles.exit_criteria: Generic public behavior preserves order and bounds at every depth, avoids Python repr and tool-name logic, and raises ConfigError with usable field/path context for missing, non-list, or wrongly typed runtime collection data; focused tests and file-scoped gates pass.

cycles.name: UTF-8 text budget enforcement

deliverables.description: TextBudgetLimiter enforces the configured UTF-8 byte ceiling.
Overflow reserves the complete cache reference and correct notice before body content.
Truncation preserves code points, prefers blocks/lines, and closes intersected fenced blocks.
Cache-unavailable truncation stays bounded without claiming cached completeness.

cycles.exit_criteria: Every limiter result is valid UTF-8 and within budget; available URI and notice survive; cache-failure text is truthful; focused tests and file-scoped gates pass.

cycles.name: Structured DTO presentation refactor

deliverables.description: WorkflowStateStatus represents available, missing, unreadable, and invalid-phase states; GetWorkContextTool emits enum/supporting data and no warning/recovery prose.
Frozen ValidationIssueDTO records preserve message, severity, line, column, and code through ValidationService, ArtifactManager, and SafeEditOutput.
RunTestsOutput exposes numeric duration_seconds; PytestRunner parses duration without producing presentation wording.
Public-contract tests cover every enum path, structured validation propagation, absent locations/codes, parsed/missing duration, and immutable DTO behavior.
No new tool, manager, or service branch produces user-facing labels, layout, warnings, or recovery prose.

cycles.exit_criteria: Structured data reaches each tool DTO without human-facing composition and every affected public contract has durable tests; no diagnostic evidence, tool input, or success/error semantic is changed beyond the Approved Strategy.

cycles.name: TextPresenter integration and complete tool rollout

deliverables.description: TextPresenter composes scalar text, collections, instructions, notes, fallback, reserved URI, and final limiter in approved order.
All thirteen collection tools declare valid collections and max_items within the complete 50-tool configuration.
Four scalar tools expose approved additions and get_issue labels are bounded to ten.
run_quality_gates and validate_template use outcome-neutral wording.
Representative verification outputs expose bounded actionable rows while excluding verbose fields.
Integration evidence proves complete cached DTOs and separately embedded validation resources remain unchanged.
A template intentionally retained by the approved audit remains byte-for-byte unchanged below budget and limiter-only different above it.
Every one of the 50 registered tool templates is implemented or explicitly confirmed against the approved field-audit inline/cache-only target.
Structural evidence classifies every tool-specific DTO field inline or cache-only and ties each cache-only choice to an approved rationale category.
Bundled presentation.yaml has exact bidirectional parity with the runtime public-tool registry; missing, obsolete, or duplicate identities fail startup.
All seven duplicate presentation fields and RunTestsOutput.summary_line are absent from DTOs, producers, templates, and tests with no compatibility aliases or dual writes.
get_work_context enum warnings, SafeEdit structured issues, and run_tests numeric duration are rendered exclusively through declarative configuration and remain complete in cache.

cycles.exit_criteria: Startup accepts exact 50-tool parity; every approved field-audit row is closed; all approved legacy fields are absent; structured warnings, issues, and duration are actionable and bounded; cache publication reflects the approved DTO clean breaks; retained compact templates are compatible below budget; no tool-name dispatch.
